title: Cobblemon-DH-Estable
description: Mod pack for  cobblemon + DH + vanilla hardcoregameplay, no bugs
body:
**Modpack made for a complete vanilla survival rpg experience, which takes as a base the 1.21.1 best fabric mods to date.**

Suggestions, comments and recommendations to [Discord](https://discord.gg/gmUDdY2s)

 ✔️ Shader compatibility with [Distant horizons](https://modrinth.com/mod/distanthorizons), [Tectonic](https://modrinth.com/datapack/tectonic),
[Cobblemon](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblemon)

 ✔️ 200+ Seamless Mods stability
 
 ✔️ Balanced and complex gameplay weapons, tools, gear and blocks limited by personal level, talent, jobs and skill builds ([Pufferfish's Skills],[Combat & RPG series]
 
 ✔️ All time favorite mods [cc-tweaked](https://modrinth.com/mod/cc-tweaked), [Farmer's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight-refabricated), [Dungeons and Taverns](https://modrinth.com/datapack/dungeons-and-taverns), [fresh animations](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-animations), [immersive aircraft](https://modrinth.com/mod/immersive-aircraft), [xaeros map](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-world-map) and many more!!.
